triggers.description: A single child's shoe, the synthetic sole stiff with dried mud. {name} holds it by the heel. The laces are tied in a double knot.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} places the shoe on a shelf. 'Secure the perimeter,' they say, their voice flat.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} drops the shoe and stares at the concrete wall. They do not report for their next shift rotation.

triggers.description: A charred photograph, the emulsion bubbled from heat. A family stands in front of a house. {name} studies the height of the youngest figure.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} slides the photo into their pocket. 'We have work to do,' they state, returning to the task list.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} presses the photograph flat against the table. They sit in silence until the generator cycles down.

triggers.description: A sealed letter. The postmark is dated the morning the network went down. {name} weighs the envelope in their palm.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} breaks the seal, reads the single page, and burns it in the stove. They return to their station.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} refuses to open the envelope. They place it in their footlocker and do not speak for thirty-six hours.

triggers.description: A red wool mitten with a rusted safety pin attached to the cuff. The wool smells faintly of damp earth.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} unpins the rusted safety pin, adding it to the scrap tin. 'Usable metal,' they note.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} holds the mitten in both hands. The missing pair is an unsolved equation. They sit motionless on the floor.

triggers.description: A pair of identification tags on a beaded chain. Half-melted, but the blood type is still legible. {name} reads the stamp format.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} drops the tags into the supply bin. 'Material acquired,' they report, posture rigid.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} reads the designation on the tag. Their jaw locks. They refuse all commands for the remainder of the day.

triggers.description: A tarnished service medal in a cracked plastic presentation box. The ribbon is singed.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} closes the box. 'The brass can be melted down,' they say, moving back to the workbench.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} stares at the tarnished metal. 'We were issued these instead of rations.' They return to their cot.

triggers.description: A military field dressing kit, the vacuum seal still intact. {name} checks the lot number and expiration date.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} logs the kit into the medical inventory. 'Viable sterile supplies,' they note. The medic's drill holds.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} traces the intact seal. 'We ran out of these on the second day.' They abandon their post.

triggers.description: A petrol lighter engraved with a unit designation. The wheel strikes on the first try. It smells heavily of kerosene.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} snaps the lighter shut. 'Functional ignition source. Good for the stockpile.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} stares into the small yellow flame until the casing burns their fingers. They do not react to the burn.

triggers.description: A bronze campaign medal. The pin mechanism on the ribbon is bent at a sharp angle.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} straightens the pin with a pair of pliers. 'Salvageable hardware.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} drops the medal on the concrete floor. 'They issued these while the rail lines burned.' They walk out of the room.

triggers.description: A stethoscope. The rubber tubing is stiff and cracking, but the diaphragm is intact. {name} hooks it around their neck instinctively.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} taps the diaphragm. 'Still acoustic,' they note. They adjust the earpieces and return to the triage logs.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} places the bell against their own chest, listening to the heavy thump. They sit with their eyes closed for hours.

triggers.description: A water-damaged patient chart attached to a rust-stained clipboard. {name} traces the faded medical shorthand.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} reads the chart. 'Discharged to home,' they read aloud. They set the clipboard down and resume inventory.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} cannot stop reading the chart. 'I didn't discharge this one,' they whisper. 'The beds were full.' They do not sleep.

triggers.description: A hospital staff photograph. The film is radiation-fogged, but the scrubs and faces are recognizable.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} studies the photo. 'Shift B. Good diagnostics team.' They fold the photo away and stand.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} counts the faces. 'Twelve in the ward,' they say quietly. 'I'm the only one left.' They miss the next rationing cycle.

triggers.description: An upside-down fob watch with a red seconds hand for timing pulses. {name} touches the crown, counting out fifteen seconds by pure reflex.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} pins the watch to their jacket. 'Sixty beats means another minute won,' they say, moving toward the bunks.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} watches the red hand sweep. 'We had eighty beds and four IV bags. I just kept counting pulses until they stopped.'

triggers.description: A spiral-bound notebook. Inside are arithmetic problems written in heavy, uneven pencil. {name} turns the pages.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} finds a blank page and writes out a mechanical diagram. 'The survivors will need practical instruction.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} reads the name on the cover. 'Sarah was in third period,' they state. 'She would be fourteen today.' They sit staring at the wall.

triggers.description: A dusty cardboard box of colored chalk. {name} takes a piece of white chalk and tests it against the concrete.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} marks out a grid on the wall to track rationing. 'Structure is required,' they state.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} draws a crude house on the concrete. 'Thirty-two children in that room,' they say. They drop the chalk and refuse to eat.

triggers.description: A wooden rubber stamp reading 'EXCELLENT WORK'. The ink pad is dry. {name} presses it dry against the palm of their hand.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} looks at the faint red dust on their skin. 'Metrics still matter,' they say, turning back to the ledger.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} stares at the wooden handle. 'They worked so hard for a red star,' they whisper. 'None of it stopped the blast wave.'

triggers.description: A voltage tester pen, the plastic casing cracked but the indicator LED intact. {name} tests it against a live battery terminal. It blinks.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} clips the tester to their collar. 'I can patch the grid with this,' they say, already tracing the conduit lines.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} presses the tester against a dead wire. 'My crew was in the substation,' they say. 'The EMP got them before the flash did.'

triggers.description: A micrometer still in its felt-lined wooden box. {name} zeroes the anvil against a piece of scrap steel.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} slides the micrometer into a padded pocket. 'Tolerance is the difference between surviving and failing,' they say.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} attempts to measure a stress fracture in the concrete wall. 'The tolerances are gone,' they repeat, leaving their tools on the floor.

triggers.description: A vernier caliper. The thumb wheel is polished completely smooth from decades of use. {name} slides the jaw closed.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} inspects the zero alignment. 'If we measure true, the patch will hold,' they state, returning to the air scrubber.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} drops the caliper. 'We machined to half a thousandth. Now we tie it together with rusty wire.' They do not finish the repair.

triggers.description: A harvest ledger recording bushels of rye, rainfall data, and frost dates. The last twenty years are meticulously documented.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} reads the soil notes from a drought year. 'The dirt recovers,' they say, assigning themselves an extra ration-prep shift.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} traces the final, unfinished column of ink. 'Three hundred acres in the ground. It burned before the harvest.' They stare at the page.

triggers.description: An index card with penciled notes for pickling. A marginal note reads: 'Save three jars for spring planting.'
triggers.motivation_text: {name} reviews the salt ratios. 'We can adjust this for the dried protein,' they say, moving to the kitchen station.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} stares at the card. 'They saved three jars every year,' they whisper. 'There is no spring planting.' They leave the kitchen.

triggers.description: A nickel-plated ticket punch that cuts a five-pointed star. {name} depresses the lever, producing a sharp, mechanical click.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} cycles the punch twice more. 'Systems require schedules,' they state, returning to the maintenance log.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} stares at the punch. 'The 6:15 was fully loaded when the sirens triggered. It never reached the terminus.' They sit down.

triggers.description: Heavy split-leather work gloves, black with industrial grease. The right thumb has been repaired with heavy copper wire.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} pulls on the stiff leather. 'These have rebuilt turbines,' they say, moving toward the failing generator.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} rubs the copper stitching. 'The man who wore these locked himself in the reactor hall to drop the rods.' They refuse to wear them.

triggers.description: A heavy brass foundry whistle. The internal pea rattles with the cadence of a shift change.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} turns the brass in their palm. 'First whistle is warning, second is work,' they state, beginning the shift.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} grips the whistle. 'The foreman blew this twice for evacuation before the roof collapsed.' They remain frozen.

triggers.description: A stamped brass miner's tag, number 142. Designed to hang on the surface board until the crew returned to daylight.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} polishes the number with a thumb. 'You take a tag, you pull your shift, you return it.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} stares at the tag. 'This never went back on the surface board. They're still down there.' They do not report for work.

triggers.description: A brass door key on a leather fob stamped '4B'. The high-rise it locked was incinerated in the first hour.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} drops the key into a scrap bucket. 'Brass melts. We need the raw material,' they say.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} turns the key in their fingers. 'I locked the deadbolt when the sirens started. As if a wooden door mattered.'

triggers.description: A pocket notebook of daily errands, dry cleaner receipts, and phone numbers. The entries stop mid-sentence on page fourteen.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} tears out the used pages to use as tinder. 'Clean paper for the ledger,' they state.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} reads the final entry: 'Pick up anniversary cake at 5.' They close the book and walk away.

triggers.description: A plain gold band. The inner curve is worn thin from decades of friction against skin.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} places the ring in the trade lockbox. 'High-value barter item,' they note mechanically.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} holds the ring in their palm. The metal is freezing cold. They sit in silence for the rest of the shift.

triggers.description: A color photograph. One figure is blurry from running back after setting the mechanical shutter timer.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} slides the photo into their pack. 'Proof of prior habitation,' they state.
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} stares at the blurred figure. 'They were all dead two hours after this was taken.' They refuse to work.

triggers.description: An unsent letter. The ink is heavily smeared by water damage.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} reads the legible sentences, then files it. 'Archived for the record.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} attempts to read the smeared ink. They set it down and refuse to speak to anyone.

triggers.description: A paper transit transfer for the 7:15 AM line, punched twice. Standard commuter issue.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} uses the paper to shim a wobbly workbench leg. 'Practical application.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} reads the timestamp. 'They were on the bus when the flash hit.' They abandon their station.

triggers.description: A scrap of paper listing butter, flour, and birthday candles. Three items are crossed out.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} writes shelter inventory on the blank side. 'Paper is paper.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} traces the uncrossed words. 'They never got the candles.' They skip their meal ration.

triggers.description: A speckled blue tin mug. The rim is chipped black where teeth rested against it every morning.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} clips the mug to their belt. 'Durable container. We'll boil water in it.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} runs a finger over the chipped enamel. 'My father had one like this,' they whisper. They do not report for work.

triggers.description: A plastic pocket comb. Three teeth are broken off.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} drops it in the wash basin. 'Hygiene protocol dictates we boil this before use.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} looks at the broken plastic teeth. 'They threw these away by the gross. Now it's the only one left.'

triggers.description: A cardboard matchbook advertising a 24-hour diner. Seven matches remain.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} strikes a match to test the phosphorus. 'Dry ignition source. Add to the stockpile.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} reads the address on the cover. 'That entire grid square is a glass crater.' They drop the matches.

triggers.description: A faded thermal receipt for three cans of peaches and a newspaper.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} crumples the receipt. 'Useless paper. Throw it in the stove.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} stares at the timestamp. 'Two hours later the sirens began.' They refuse to speak.

triggers.description: A cheap brass four-leaf clover keyring from a gas station.
triggers.motivation_text: {name} tosses the charm into the scrap tin. 'Usable brass for the smelter.'
triggers.breakdown_text: {name} stares at the four leaves. 'Not lucky enough,' they whisper, walking away from their station.
